tldr: Pluto in the 10th house: power becomes personal through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
body:
With Pluto in the 10th house, this part of you intensifies career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction. Pluto describes power, pressure, truth, control, fear, attachment, and deep change. In practice, this brings attention to the work, responsibilities, goals, and public roles that shape how you are seen.

When this placement is supported, your direction can become more visible, accountable, and real. Pluto can become depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried.

When it is strained, achievement or approval can start carrying too much of your identity. The harder pattern can show up as control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change.
gift: depth, honesty, resilience, and the ability to face what has been buried expressed through career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
challenge: control, obsession, compulsion, or trying to force an outcome that needs to change around career, visibility, reputation, authority, ambition, and public direction.
